info.title: InternSetu API
info.description: AI-assisted internship recommendation engine for PM Internship Scheme

patch.description: Remember the user's UI language so web and mobile show the same one.

get.description: All data held about the user (DPDP right to access). Recommendations are calculated on demand, not stored.
Allowed values for the 'preferred duration' dropdown (profile field duration_preference).

Public. "What have you done?" tiles for the skills picker: icon, en/hi/mr label and the skill ids each one adds.
Skills that are not in the loaded taxonomy are dropped, and an activity with no skills left is hidden.
Public. Options for dropdowns / chips / search-as-you-type (English names + stable ids).

get.description: Top 3 to 5 internships. If nothing is eligible, `recommendations` is empty and `nearest` explains what is missing.

get.description: Public. Official portal link and the papers to keep ready before applying. Nothing is stored; Aadhaar is never collected.
Lets the web app confirm the logged-in user really is an admin.

post.description:
CSV columns: external_id(optional), company_name, title, description, sector, role, location, min_education,
degree, field_of_study, duration, stipend_inr_per_month, mandatory_skills, preferred_skills (use ; between skills),
application_url, facilities. Names are matched to the taxonomy (names or synonyms).

ProfileUpdate.title: ProfileUpdate
ProfileUpdate.description:
Send only the fields you want to change (save step by step). A list replaces the old list.
Sending null for a single value clears it.
